# Awtsmoos.com Documentation

The Awtsmoos lets one repository be understood at several depths: learn the ideas, explore exhaustive evidence, open the owning source, then verify with tests/runtime.

This is the canonical human entry for `/Users/awtsmoos/work/Awtsmoos.com`. `geelooy/` is the default public root; `ayzarim/` holds major server/runtime infrastructure; root `index.js` coordinates HTTP, WebSocket upgrades, SMTP, and a few direct handlers.

## Fastest doorway — `/docs/`

The public documentation application has four primary modes:

- **Learn** — five source-backed curricula with browser-local progress.
- **API Explorer** — every currently discovered API route, filterable by family, syntax health, static/dynamic shape, method evidence, source, callers, and tests.
- **Project Explorer** — every current project boundary, filterable by type, public-entry/test/docs evidence, dependencies, entries, and path text.
- **Documents** — global search, categories/projects, safe Markdown reading, provenance, favorites/recents, deep links, and retrieval-first Ask.

Open `/docs/?view=learn`, `/docs/?view=api`, or `/docs/?view=projects` directly.

## Learn before memorizing

Start at [LEARN/README.md](LEARN/README.md). Deeper tutorials live under [TUTORIALS/README.md](TUTORIALS/README.md), including all API families, server/runtime systems, Social/content domains, and [project-family guides](TUTORIALS/PROJECTS/README.md).

## Exhaustive generated teaching

- [GENERATED/API_TUTORIAL_INDEX.md](GENERATED/API_TUTORIAL_INDEX.md) — one generated tutorial per current API route.
- [GENERATED/PROJECT_TUTORIAL_INDEX.md](GENERATED/PROJECT_TUTORIAL_INDEX.md) — one generated tutorial per current project boundary.
- [GENERATED/PROJECT_TYPE_SUMMARY.md](GENERATED/PROJECT_TYPE_SUMMARY.md) — current project-type evidence summary.

Generated evidence remains conservative. Unknown API methods remain unknown. Project imports/symbols/tests/public entries remain qualified lexical/discovery evidence rather than runtime guarantees.

## Enter by task

- API call or route → [API/README.md](API/README.md) → route tutorial → source.
- Project/system boundary → [PROJECTS/README.md](PROJECTS/README.md) → project tutorial → dependency/entry evidence → source.
- Social/content → [LEARN/CONTENT_PLATFORM_101.md](LEARN/CONTENT_PLATFORM_101.md).
- Server lifecycle/routing → [LEARN/SERVER_LIFECYCLE_101.md](LEARN/SERVER_LIFECYCLE_101.md).
- Realtime → [WEBSOCKETS/README.md](WEBSOCKETS/README.md).
- Persistence → [DATA/README.md](DATA/README.md).
- Security/trust → [SECURITY/README.md](SECURITY/README.md).
- Tests → [TEST_INDEX.md](TEST_INDEX.md).
- AI discovery → [AI/README.md](AI/README.md), [AI/MANIFEST.json](AI/MANIFEST.json), [AI/API_TUTORIALS/MANIFEST.json](AI/API_TUTORIALS/MANIFEST.json), and root `llms.txt`.

## Documentation layers

1. **Human learning/manuals** explain meaning, trust, workflow, caveats, and change strategy.
2. **Generated route/project teaching** enumerates volatile source facts exhaustively.
3. **AI records** provide bounded machine navigation into projects and API routes.
4. **Public publication** converts intentional documentation/evidence into transport-bounded browser data.
5. **Current source/tests/runtime** remain final authority.

Regenerate with `node scripts/docs/generate-docs.js`; test route/project/search behavior with focused tests; validate with `node scripts/docs/validate-docs.js`.
